## The AI teammate with full context,

Ask Metaview

Why Metaview

## AI-native recruiting built for clarity, efficiency & precision.

### Enterprise collaboration

One platform where recruiters, hiring managers, and AI agents share context, keeping everyone aligned on criteria, calibrated on candidates, and moving in the same direction.

### Extreme flexibility

Configure every workflow, output, and agent to match your exact ways of working. Your scorecards, your hiring process, and your definition of “great.” With reporting that answers your team’s most pressing questions.

### Proactive, autonomous agents

Use AI agents to source, screen, and surface high-fit candidates around the clock. Acting on your behalf, autonomously, with the criteria guardrails you define.

### Single layer of context

Infuse your job requirements, interview history, team preferences, and company knowledge throughout one intelligence layer. Outputs get sharper with every hire, and every choice becomes clearer, faster.

![Metaview product interface](https://www.metaview.ai/_next/image?url=%2F_next%2Fstatic%2Fimmutable%2Fmedia%2Fwhy-metaview.0l_iyqa2neips.jpg&w=3840&q=75)

AI orchestration with human guardrails

## Enterprise-level security and controls.

**Define what the agent can and can't do** using shared company knowledge and rules.

**Automatically get alerts** for non-compliant behavior or inconsistencies.

**Access a full audit trail**

## What we guarantee no matter the plan.

Context-aware AI.01

Metaview understands more than just inputs. It interprets context, handles unstructured data, and connects the dots across your workflows so you always get relevant, actionable insights.

Ethical AI & data use.02

Your data belongs to you. We’re committed to the responsible use of AI, backed by industry-leading security and privacy practices that keep your information safe, compliant, and confidential.

Expert, accessible support.03

Metaview’s platform is designed to be intuitive, but real success comes with expert guidance. Our team, including Forward Deployed Talent Engineers, provides quick, thoughtful support from people who understand both the product and your goals.

Extreme flexibility.04

Metaview is built to adapt to you, not the other way around. It configures to your workflows and supports any use case you throw at it. And because it learns your organization’s patterns, it continuously improves alongside you.

Don't just take our word.
